A floating, always-on-top bar that shows how much of your Claude Code subscription is left and how long until it resets — the same 5-hour and weekly numbers `/usage` reports, without opening a terminal.

It reads the OAuth credentials Claude Code already keeps on this machine, so there is no separate login to set up. The token stays in the main process and is re-read on every poll, so it never goes stale after Claude Code refreshes it.

**Install:** download `Claude-Usage-Setup-1.0.0.exe` and run it. The installer is not code-signed, so Windows will show an "unknown publisher" warning — choose *More info* then *Run anyway*.

**Requirements:** Windows 10/11 x64, with Claude Code signed in at least once.

**In the box**
- 5-hour session and weekly meters, plus optional per-model weekly and pay-as-you-go credit rows
- Nine screen anchors or free placement, compact mode, adjustable opacity, click-through
- Sits over the taskbar if you want it to, and steps aside for fullscreen video
- Lives in the tray; starts with Windows if you ask it to

Built on Electron 43.3.0 (Chromium 150).
